title: Unit Event — Light Up the Fire

meta.Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD's explosive third event has roused expectations that the team might actually surpass RAD WEEKEND. That's when Taiga summons them for "an important conversation"...

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (We're seeing their true capabilities here.)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (A part of me has been wondering this whole time...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: If anyone's going to surpass what happened that night, I'd have to say...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: It's been three years since that night...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (I guess it's about time I fulfilled my promise...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (Once the cafe service ends, I'll close up the place and go find them...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (Based on how Taiga was behaving, I bet he's also going to want to say something before he leaves...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Kids sure do grow up fast, Nagi...

rows.Speaker: Regular
rows.Line:
Hey, Ken!
Everything okay? You look concerned.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, I was just thinking about something.
What'll it be? The usual?
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Alright, Akito, An!
Here are your sandwiches and coffee.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Toya, here are your cookies and coffee.
You ordered the tea and pancakes, right, Kohane?! Enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This is...

rows.Speaker: Akito & An
rows.Line:
Delicious.
Amazing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Way to go, Rin! You said you made this mustard sauce yourself? It's got a kick to it, and it goes so well with the ham!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I think you're all set to fill in for MEIKO whenever she's not around!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You definitely delivered on your words.
This is really good. Nice work.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Heehee! Of course it is!
This is a piece of pie for us!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I wasn't sure how you'd do in MEIKO's place, but I guess my worries were misplaced.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, Len, this coffee you made is very good.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, I agree!
And my mouth can't believe how fluffy these pancakes are.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Heh. This was nothing!
Feel free to order from me anytime!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Anyway... You guys are gonna watch the video of your third event after you eat, right?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh... That's right!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Our plan was to watch it with everyone...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But it sounds like MEIKO and the others aren't gonna be back for a while. So, call it a little reward for making all this delicious food for us.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow, look at Kohane's solo!
You sound amazing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe... Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was really nervous about it at first... But, everyone gave me the push I needed to stand up there on my own.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You really did put on an outstanding performance, Azusawa. You had me transfixed.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Same here.
It sorta reminded me of the way RAD WEEKEND began...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wh-What? Are you talking about Nagi...?!
No, what I did was nothing compared to...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Relax. I said sorta.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But you did put on a pretty incredible performance.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-Thanks...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Yeah, she sounded amazing...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Kohane just keeps getting better and better. In other words, she's getting closer and closer...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (To Aunt Nagi. To her level...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But what about me...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(No, stop.
Don't beat yourself up.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(I can get there too...
No, I will get there...!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wooow!!!
That was such an amazing event!!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And when the four of you sang at the end...! That was so mind-blowingly cool!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, that was probably the best performance you guys have ever put on!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, you two!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Next time, we'll put on another performance like this one... No, we're gonna do even better.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'm sure we can!
I mean, all the locals seem really excited about seeing our next event...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Speaking of which, it seems like more of them have been coming to talk to us since our last one. Their expectations of us must've increased quite a lot...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh... Yeah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The guy from the record store even told me that everyone from around town thinks we might have what it takes to actually surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Really?
Hehe. That's so nice...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's nice that we're finally getting noticed, but it also means that we can't let our guard down.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. Let's keep doing our best moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, are you guys gonna practice here after this?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, we're meeting up with some people, so we actually need to get going soon.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Who are you meeting?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Uncle Taiga asked us to meet him with Arata and the others this evening.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Taiga did? Why?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We don't actually know exactly.
But he said it's something important...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Something important? Like what...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He'll be leaving to go on his US tour soon, so he may be leaving us with some parting words...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What?! A US tour?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, he's heading back to the US.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Really? But that's so far away...
Which is all the more reason to see him before he leaves!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: There could also be something else he wants to say. I mean, who knows what that guy's thinking most of the time...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, it's almost time for us to meet up with Tono and the others. We gotta go.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay.
Thanks again, you two! We'll be back soon!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: See you! Have fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Alright, let's start cleaning up!
After all, MEIKO said that our job's not over until the cups and stuff are all back on the shelves.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Right!
Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Isn't this An's handkerchief?
Did she forget it?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh... Well, I guess we'll just have to give it back to her next time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hmm... But what if we forget...?
Shouldn't one of us go let her know it's here before we do?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Good point! Then, wanna go tell her?
Just don't get seen by anyone, okay?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Got it!
I'll be right back!
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, there he is! Uncle Taiga!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hey, sorry for asking you all to meet so suddenly...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, it's our pleasure.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we were a little surprised to hear that you have “something important” to talk about. Also, there's like no one else here...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: It's nice, right? I come here occasionally when I need to get away from things. It's my little secret spot.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But you're not here to tell us about this spot of yours, are you...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Haha. You're always in such a hurry.
There are a few things that I need to tell you all, so I'll cover them one at a time...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: First, you may've already heard from Little Miss Diva here... But I'll be returning to the US to go on tour.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: The guys over there have been hounding me about not coming back sooner. To be fair, I have been here for a while now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Was that my fault...?
Did teaching me keep you from going back...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If so, I'm really sorry for taking up so much of your time...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
There's no need for you to apologize.
I stayed because I wanted to.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: And I was rewarded for doing so.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Rewarded...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Your third event.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You guys put on a great event, and I'm genuinely glad that I was able to see it before I left.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: And it seems like you know understand what it means to “take a good look at this city”.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yes!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I understand the importance of all the people who want to hear us sing, and wanting them to listen to our music...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Their support is the source of our strength... I think that's what you meant!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
A quick student takes all the fun out of it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? No, I... I-I'm sorry!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
I was just kidding.
Anyway, you put on a great event. I haven't felt a shiver down my spine like that in a long time.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Which is why...there's something I need to tell you all now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Tell us all what...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: That as things are, your dream will never come true.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: As you all are now, even if you spend your whole lives trying, you'll never surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Never.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Uncle Taiga...?
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Even if we spend our whole lives trying...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, what do you mean by that...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Just that.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: None of you understand exactly what it is that you're trying to surpass.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I mean, how can you clear a hurdle if you don't know how high it is?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wh-What do you mean I don't understand? I saw it for myself...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but I'm having trouble grasping what exactly it is that you're trying to say, Taiga... Would you mind elaborating a bit more?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Yeah, sure.
That's why I gathered you all here today.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I'm sure you all felt this for yourself during your third event...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: A good event isn't just about each person's performance. It's also vital to work as a unit and become one with the crowd.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I mean, no one wants to see some self-absorbed jerk hog the stage.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Based on what I saw, you've established some strong bonds.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Because you can't put on a good show if you're not all motivated and working towards the same goal.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yes, we understand that...
We have to be on the same page if we really want to put on a great event.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
And RAD WEEKEND is no exception.
It was a big event for a reason.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: All the best singers were there, and we became one with the crowd. That was our goal from the start.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, that we understand...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: So, doesn't that mean we have a chance to achieve our goal...?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, I mean...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Azusawa helped us get a better idea of what it means to become one with the crowd.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
She did.
It also solidified our collective goal of wanting to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know.
You've made it this far, so it's clear that you all have potential.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: But... You're not gonna surpass it for one simple reason.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You aren't enough. Not by a long shot.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait...! Okay, yeah. Compared to you guys, we still have a lot of work to do. But if we keep improving like this, I'm sure someday—

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You're missing the point.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I don't doubt that you'll keep getting better. Even if there's a massive skill gap between me and the rest of you, your chances of reaching my level won't be zero.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: But I'm talking about what's in here. Your heart.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: That night became what it was because of one thought, one idea...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Without that, there was no way RAD WEEKEND would've become the event it did.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: One thought...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I still don't understand...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Our goal was to put on one final event worthy of the end of her life.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The end of her life...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Her...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
An, what's wrong?
Don't tell me you're still sulking...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line:
B-But...!
Aunt Nagi just left without saying anything...!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: If I knew that she was leaving for the US, I would've at least gone and told her goodbye...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Well, this is her we're talking about...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Seeing you might've made having to go just that much harder.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: But...!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: No, I'll just make her beg me for my forgiveness when she gets back!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line:
Hm...?
What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
Nothing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But... W-Wait, that's... Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: It was the last event for a certain musician.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: We gave absolutely everything we had and sang ourselves hoarse for her. And the crowd made sure they would never forget one second.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And this musician's name was...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Nagi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: RAD WEEKEND was Nagi Kotaki's final event. It was meant to be my little sister's swan song.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: She found out she was sick and had just months to live, and she decided to use what little time she had left to put on one last event in this neighborhood.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: That was RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: So, Nagi... She passed away...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What are you saying, Uncle Taiga...?
You're just joking, right...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But, she went over to the US...
I mean, everyone around town said so...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No one told me she'd—

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You of all people should know, An...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: In the eyes of the neighborhood, you and Nagi were like family...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: They'd do anything for you, including shielding you from the truth.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shielding her...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
From the truth...?
Does that mean they all worked together to lie to her...?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: N-No, that can't be possible...!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: That would mean everyone from Vivid Street...! They seriously all kept the fact that Nagi was dead quiet?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: How could a whole neighborhood hide the fact that someone had died?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Why would they do that?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: For one reason and one only. Because Nagi wanted it that way.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Please...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Can you do this? For me?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Nagi's gone...
And everyone around here knows that already.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: The only people who don't know are those who started hanging out here recently...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: And you, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No... It's not possible...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How do you expect me to believe a story like...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Everyone here's known Nagi forever.
A lot of them since she was born.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Which is why...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: They probably felt obligated to respect her final wishes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (He isn't kidding...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It's all...true.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I've never seen this look on Uncle Taiga's face before...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (So that means, Aunt Nagi, she...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (She's really...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
...
Why?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why did you keep this from me?!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Like I said, this is what Nagi wanted.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
You'll have to ask Ken about the rest.
For now, there's something else that I need to tell all of you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Something else...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Remember what I said just now? You'll probably keep getting better, and your chances of reaching my level won't be zero, even if there's a huge skill gap between us.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: The kids who saw RAD WEEKEND are all grown up now. And so, you all have a better idea of that skill gap. Am I right?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I borrowed some mics and speakers from that live house over there. You guys decide how you wanna use them.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Use these...? W-Wait, you don't mean...?!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: What?! Against Taiga...?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wh-What are you doing...?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You... You have to explain everything to me first! Tell me what happened to Aunt Nagi...! Tell me everything! Now!!!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Geez, you really are a handful. Alright, fine...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
How do you feel now, An?
Ready to dance?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
You're gonna surpass that night, right?
Nagi's last hurrah. When everyone in this town came together for her...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Wh-What do I do...?!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I-I've gotta go tell the others...!>
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: Hey, that sounded like Taiga singing just now!

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
Yeah, that booming voice...!
Wait, that's where he's singing?

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: And what are Vivid BAD SQUAD, Tono and everyone doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
This feels like...
No, they're not really gonna...

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
Are they battling against Taiga?!
I mean, even with those numbers, they don't stand a chance!

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
No, I think they can win!
I mean, they're serious about surpassing RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I was just warming up. Looks like everyone here knows when something's up.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Anyway, our stage is set.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So, let's get started.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: H-How are we supposed to beat him...?!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
(This is bad...
He only sang for a little bit, but we all feel overwhelmed.)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: (Including myself...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We just have to fight...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What he said about Nagi, the neighborhood, everything... None of it makes sense. I still have no idea what he's thinking. Even so...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I know this...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We can't run from this battle...
If we do, there's no way we'll ever be able to surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, I completely agree...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hey, how much more time do you need to come up with a plan...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: We can't make this crowd wait forever, so I'm just gonna pick someone...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Let's start with... You guys, EVER.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Looks like he's not even gonna give us a second to breathe...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Do you all feel ready...?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
Honestly, I don't think so...
This is probably the most scared of a battle we've ever been...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
But Shinonome's right...
We can't run! We have to fight!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
Alright, you guys!
Let's do this!!!

rows.Speaker: EVER Members A & B
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: W-We're going to give it everything we've got. Our determination's gotten us this far...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Your determination...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Well, you get points for spirit.
Anyway, let's begin.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: The rules are simple. The side that gets the crowd going the most wins. With this many people, we should get a clear victor.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So, you guys start us off. Take as much time as you want.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
What...?!
You're gonna regret talking down to us!

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
Hey, EVER's up first!
Man, they're so much better than most of the other teams out there!

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Show him what you've got!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah, I expected as much...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Now, it's my turn.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(...!
Th-This is the real Taiga...?!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (This is nothing like what we saw when he battled against Tono that time...!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(So much power...!
In a split second, he swept everyone up in a torrent.)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I'm getting fed up with this.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
(You've gotta be kidding me...
He just crushed us like a bug...)

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: (We never stood a chance...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Alright, that should be enough.
Next, you.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Eep...!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
I-I'm not running either...!
I'm gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I'm not scared! I don't have time to be scared...!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Haha. I like your bravery.
Anyway, enough talk. Show me what you've got.

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: Yikes...! Who is that guy?! He's horrible!

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
Isn't that Mita?
I thought he had more skill than that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
This is bad...!
Taiga has him so overwhelmed that he can't sing like he normally does...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Mita, relax...!
Go at your own pace!

rows.Line: Popularity? That has nothing to do with our dream! We wanna become the best musicians in the world!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I don't care how big those snobs' agency is. I'm not letting them walk all over us just because they agreed to have us on some TV show.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Appearing on TV did have its benefits since it gave our songs more exposure. But we didn't set out to become on-air personalities.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
I mean, seriously.
They just kept going on and on about going on variety shows and appearing in these dumb romance movies. They even had the nerve to start trying to meddle with our songs.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Hahaha. I did warn you that the way most people become famous nowadays wouldn't really be for you.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: But I do understand how someone would want a handsome guy like Ken to appear in a movie for them.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I was hoping we could stay since we owed that agency quite a bit... But we reached the final straw. We just couldn't let them encroach any further.

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: So, what are you guys gonna do now...?

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: Good question. Ken's got a college degree. You on the other hand, Taiga... You didn't even finish high school. Do you have a plan moving forward?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah, of course.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: We're gonna start our own label.

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: Your own label?!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: That's right! We had a long discussion, and we decided to start our own label here while continuing to perform!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: In other words, it's back to square one for us!

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
Talk about doing things the hard way!

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
As hard as it sounds...
It sounds like the right option for your team...

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: Then, Nagi, Ken, Taiga, we'll be rooting for you guys! My wife and son are also huge fans!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Haha!
Wait, your son only just learned to walk, didn't he? Won't we be bad influences on him?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Nah, it's all a part of getting a rounded education.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Hey, we have our own problems to deal with right now. We don't have time to be thinking about other people's families...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: We need to see if it's actually going to be possible for our label to even survive, and a whole list of other things to consider.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Yes, we know. Which is why you get to handle all of that, Ken! I mean, you're just so much better at those things than we are.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Nagi...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Hehe. We'll be counting on you, Ken!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Anyway, we're still going to become the best musicians in the world!

rows.Line:
*Sigh*

rows.Line:
...

rows.Line:
Look, I could really use a break now...

rows.Line: This is why we should've hired a driver. Then, we could've all slept as much as we wanted.

rows.Line: That costs money, which we don't have right now. Don't forget that we're not signed to a big label anymore.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Still, I can't believe how much of a toll this is taking on us. I feel like we could do a lot more when we were younger...

rows.Line: Like when we were still in school and sang for hours at COL after school?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
We were so young back then.
All we did was sing! It'd be Friday night one second, then we were rushing to school in a panic on Monday the next! Those were the days.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Oh, also!
Because of that, I remember all your fans being jealous of me since the three of us always came to school together, Ken!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Here we go, acting cool again. You've been doing that for as long as I can remember.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: But now, you're married to a charming, pretty woman like Yuka. You really don't know what life has in store for you, huh?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Haha. I thought you went to school to study, not chase after girls, college boy.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Hey, cut me some slack. It was love at first sight.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Anyway, we don't have time for this right now. If we don't make it to Osaka today, we'll have to sleep in the car.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
What...?!
Taiga, drive! Now!

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: She does.

rows.Line:

rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Since we've managed to catch a nice tailwind, we thought it'd be good to focus more on mixing our songs and stuff instead!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So, for now, be with your wife and daughter. You'd rather hang out with your daddy, right, An?

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Line:

Thanks...

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Alright, I'll see you later.

You never call me. How's it—

rows.Line: What?

rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Line:

rows.Line: So, you really only have...?

rows.Line:

rows.Line: But no amount of chemotherapy is apparently going to help.

rows.Line: I'm sorry. We'd finally made it... The deal with Burner Records, the US tour...and now this happens.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I'm really...sorry.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: But I guess we won't be able to rule the world together.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: That's not...the point...

rows.Line: Let's all just take a deep breath...

rows.Line: I mean... I'm still having trouble processing what I just heard...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Same...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:

I'm the one who's sick, but even my mind still can't seem to come to grips with it.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Still, I think I'm doing better than you two...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: When I called Mom and everyone earlier, she yelled at me for giving her such terrible news after not calling in forever. She was so distraught that I had to be the one to stay calm and get her to settle down.

rows.Speaker: Taiga

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: So, about us... About the future of RADder...

rows.Line: You two should decide what happens moving forward.

rows.Line: I mean, I'll be gone in less than six months, so I don't really have a say anymore...

rows.Speaker: Nagi

...!

rows.Line:
Taiga...
It's from Burner, but I'm putting them on hold for—

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Ken...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Sorry, but I don't think I can talk about any of that right now.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I...can't think about the future.

rows.Line:

rows.Line:
We can talk about this later.
About us, and our future...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Line: (I want to go out with a bang here... In the city I love...)

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Nagi...

rows.Line: I see...

rows.Line: As a parent, I sort of understand what you're getting at.

rows.Line: Watching youngsters grow up and reach heights that we couldn't... It's an inspiring thought.

rows.Line: Then, you'll know that we're the best!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: That our dream came true!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Because that's... That's the only thing I can do...!

rows.Line: Taiga...

rows.Line: Thanks, Taiga...

rows.Line: But...

rows.Line: I don't want you to do that for me.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: But I still love watching you do what you're so passionate about.

rows.Line: Anyway, I want this event to happen!

rows.Line: As a musician, I want to end things by having the best time in the best place in the world with my best friends.

Wow, she's still got it.

rows.Line:
I can feel it...
With each passing day, my body breaks down more.

rows.Line: Nagi...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I just wanted to grow old and keep singing here.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
You and I would've forever been single!
But we'd always have the Shiraishis, and I was going to watch An blossom into a beautiful lady...like me...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: On Vivid Street... Together...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Forever...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I don't want to die...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I want to be here...forever...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I... I want to keep singing...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I want to keep living life with you and everyone else...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Sorry...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You idiot...

rows.Line: What did I just say about acting tough...?! Have you forgotten we're family...?

rows.Line: I know... I'm sorry, Taiga...

COL

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: Whoa, this place is packed...

rows.Line: This looks like everyone from Vivid Street. Why do you think Nagi asked us to gather here?

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Thank you all for joining me here today!

rows.Line:
Straight to the point!

rows.Line: I have something incredibly important to tell you all today.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Something important...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: So, the thing is...

rows.Line: I have just a few months left to live.

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: A little while ago, I was diagnosed with pancreatic cancer... It's already too late for me.

rows.Speaker: Frizzly-Haired Record Store Clerk
rows.Line: Wh-What...? You have cancer...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Yes...
I know this is a lot to process...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
I can see how startled you all are...
But I owe all of you everything, so I felt it was my duty to tell you this without hiding anything.

rows.Speaker: Attractive Lady
rows.Line: So it's true...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Which is why I want to ask you all a couple of favors today.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: One month from now, we're going to put on my last event here!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: It's going to be the most amazing event Vivid Street has ever seen, and this place is going to be packed with everyone from around here... No, with non-locals too!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: My first wish is for you to all come and see it!

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: You want to do your last event here...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I do! And I've already come up with a name for it!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: It's going to be called RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: RAD...WEEKEND...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: COL has a special place in our hearts, so I want to relive our youth one more time here!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Just like when we gathered here on weekends way back when and sang so intensely that we lost track of day and night! That sort of energy!

rows.Speaker: Experienced Staff
rows.Line: RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: Frizzly-Haired Record Store Clerk
rows.Line: Your last hurrah...

rows.Speaker: Attractive Lady
rows.Line: I'll be there. I promise...

rows.Speaker: Attractive Lady
rows.Line: I want to give you the right send-off!

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line:
...
M-Me too...!

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: Us too!

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: Anything for you, Nagi! Let's blow the roof off this place!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, you guys.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: But I have one more wish...!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: This is going to sound a little weird...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: But, when I'm dead... Please don't say that I am.

rows.Speaker: Experienced Staff
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: Wh-What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah, I know it sounds strange...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: So, to be more specific, I'd like for you all to tell everyone that I'm off somewhere far away instead of dead...

rows.Speaker: Frizzly-Haired Record Store Clerk
rows.Line: Wait, why...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Because I love this city just that much.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I want to keep living and loving life with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: But that's not going to be possible...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: So, I...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I want all of you to say that I'm off singing somewhere else.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: That way, I feel that I'll always be in your hearts even after I'm gone.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I know. What I'm asking is really strange...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: But this is one last favor... I mean, really my last.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Can you do this? For me?

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Just when I thought you were all grown up, you start acting like a little kid again.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: So, in other words, you want us all to bend over backwards to lie to everyone we talk to, right?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Then, how about we do this?

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Nagi, in order to become a better singer, you've decided to train overseas where you'll get to experience real street music, while also having to overcome cultural and language barriers.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: We'll be lying to everyone anyway, so why not make it so you never stopped chasing after your dream, right?

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: By telling others that story, we'll always be able to look back on the time you were with us, when we were waiting for you three to make your dreams come true.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Sir...?

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: How does that sound, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: I think it suits her. After all, she always liked reaching for the stars...

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: You spent entire nights here as a kid singing alongside grown-ups, so it only makes sense that you want to keep rocking the world in dreams even after you close your eyes for the last time.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: You shot for the moon in life, Nagi, so I believe this fits you perfectly.

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: I agree...

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: Yeah, it's a crazy story... But a fun one too.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: Hey, Nagi's crying like she used to when she was little!

rows.Speaker: Attractive Lady
rows.Line:
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: N-No fair! Don't bring her up now...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Wait, I forgot about An!
I'm really sorry, but I have one last wish!

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Hm? Yes?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Please don't tell An about any of this.

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Frizzly-Haired Record Store Clerk
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! An's gonna hate us all so much when she finds out!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I know I'm asking a lot...

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: It's okay, Nagi.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: An won't like it when she learns the truth, but I also have a feeling that she'll eventually understand why you did this.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: You think so...? I hope you're right...

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
So, everyone!
We'll see you at RAD WEEKEND one month from now! Get ready for a show the likes of which you've never seen before!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: What she said! It's gonna be such an unbelievable night that no one's gonna know what to do with themselves!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
We'd better see you there!
It's going to be the best event any of us have ever put on in our lives!

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line:
Hehe. That takes me back...
It reminds me of all the times they sang until they dropped.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line:
RAD WEEKEND...
I'll be looking forward to it.
RAD WEEKEND

rows.Line: Oh, look. The crowd's starting to file in.

rows.Speaker: RUST Member
rows.Line:
Hey, you're right.

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Are you guys all ready?

rows.Line: Of course. We're ready to blast off whenever.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Hehe. That's what I like to hear!

rows.Line: Thank you all so much for joining us today.

rows.Line: My time's fast approaching, so I've been really worried about falling asleep...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I've been so afraid that I wouldn't wake up.

rows.Line: But practicing with you guys made me forget what's happening to me and how little time I have left.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: So, again, thank you.

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Let's go out there and give RAD WEEKEND absolutely everything we have!

rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Line: Well then, I'll go start us off!

rows.Line: (I love it so much.)

rows.Line: Something seems wrong...

rows.Line: What's going on?

rows.Line: Aunt Nagi...?

rows.Line: (As much as I want to keep savoring this, I don't have time to dawdle by myself...)

rows.Line: (With my next breath, everything begins. Including my final chapter...)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: (So, open your eyes. Take a deep breath...)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: (As long as everyone in this city keeps on living, I'll keep on singing!)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Everyone...
I'm giving this show absolutely everything I have!
So try to keep up, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Taiga?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: This atmosphere feels different...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
It's like nothing I've ever felt before.
Not here. Not overseas...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: This heat. This burning sensation. It's like my body's melting from the inside out...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: And Nagi's singing is the source.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: She's lighting the way for the next generation.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Look at their faces...
They have no idea what it's really like.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Oh, they'll find out...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: In due time, they'll learn just how hard this life is.

rows.Speaker: Nagi's Voice
rows.Line:
Next, we have RUST!
They're all yours!

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member
rows.Line: Thanks, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: And last but not least... Us!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: RADder!!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: That's our cue, Taiga. Let's go.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Alright, I heard you.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Get it together, boys.
Quit looking like grumpy old men.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Let's just try to have fun today, alright?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: And make this an unforgettable day.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Yeah, she's right...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Let's do this...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (Wow, this energy...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
(Us, the crowd, this venue...
It's like we're all being melted down together.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (Like back in the day.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (When we spent entire weekends together singing at COL. We didn't care who listened to us and never thought about going pro. We were free.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (We got to sing our music the way we wanted. It's all that mattered to us... Haha. Our thought process was so simple.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (This is all we want to do...!!)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (That's right. You'll want to stand up here someday...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (And it's my job to...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: (Man, this is the best!)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: (Nagi won't like me thinking this, but I wouldn't mind taking my last breath here!!!)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: (Nagi, Ken, everyone from around town... They're all here...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: (This is the best place to be in the world right now!!!)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: (Nagi, Ken...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: (I... I don't want this to ever end...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
(What we made together...
The best music in the world...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
(I'll keep singing even in the afterlife.
I'm never letting go of it.)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I don't want you to do that for me.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I want you two to walk your own paths and follow your own dreams.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
(Nagi...
I'm not doing this for you.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
(It's over...?
Is that really it...?)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Nice work, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
That was such an incredible event!
Like seriously the best!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Thank you guys so much for agreeing to do this!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Nagi...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
It doesn't matter what you say.
My goals aren't gonna change.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I'm gonna show the world that our music is the best.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: For me. No one else...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So, Ken, how about you...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I realized something today.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: All we want to do is sing like nothing else matters and feel that exhilaration we always used to.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Huh?
Of course that's what we wanna do. Just because you're that dense doesn't mean the rest of us are.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
True.
Still, I saw An's face right after that and thought...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I want to see what happens next.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I want to see how the seeds we planted today grow.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I want to see what the next generation looks like.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I want to see what happens. That's how I feel.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Heh, I see.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I knew that people's brains turned to mush after having kids, but to think that it'd happen to you.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Hey, can't you just say that I'm seeing things more clearly now?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Then, I'll just have to keep watching how you two do from up above!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Geez, talk about being nosy...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I agree. I'm not sure how I feel about having you constantly looking over my shoulder.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: What?! You guys are so awful!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Anyway, that's it for me as a musician!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: And I have a feeling...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: That the next generation of singers is going to help keep our dream alive.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Nagi...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (I've never seen Nagi in such a frail state...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (It hasn't even been a month since RAD WEEKEND...)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Oh, you two came...
Sorry, I didn't see you there...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: No, we just got here a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: And we brought you some snacks. Mom visits sometimes too, right? If it seems like too much, you two can split them.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Okay, thanks.

rows.Line: For better or worse, Vivid Street's never been crazier. We've been seeing all sorts of musicians. Some seem serious, but others not so much.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah. Some have already given up after realizing that they're never gonna surpass us. But others are still trying despite that.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I see... What about An?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Do you really need to ask?
She's been asking all her friends about putting on their own event.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: She has...?! That's my girl. Way to take the initiative!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Yeah, she always leaps before she looks. Like a certain someone...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Quit acting like you're any different. What about you?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
I mean, retiring to start a cafe?
Where's Ken and what did you do with him...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: You're opening up a cafe? That's a pretty big decision. What did Yuka say? Was she mad?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Yeah, a little.
But she understood after we talked it out.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I have a feeling that the next generation is going to have its fair share of struggles, so I want to provide them with a place where they can rest and take a break...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:

An's been looking for a partner she can trust because she wants to become just like us.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Interesting. An's partner. I wonder who that's going to be. But someone just as cheerful and energetic might not be a good idea. I feel like they'd fight and argue a lot.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Could be someone much more mild-mannered, you know? I mean, you used to be such a crybaby who clung to people for comfort, but you were so stubborn too.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Shut up. This isn't about me.
But I do agree that someone less excitable might be best for her...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: An hates losing, but she's also great at looking after others.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
I really hope she finds someone she likes.
But it might take a while to find someone as good a singer as An.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I wish I could see who she ends up with...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
...
You're really sure about not telling An what's happening?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I can bring An by if you let me tell her. I mean, don't you want to talk to her one last time?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I do, but...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: It's okay, Ken. Don't tell her.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Because I believe in what I said.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: If anyone's going to succeed us, I'm absolutely positive that An will be one of those people.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: She grew up on Vivid Street being showered with so much love and affection. And she loves everyone back. That's why I think she's so great at expressing herself through song.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: She's always willing to lend those in need a hand. She has no trouble cheering others up when they feel scared. She can sing for someone else's sake...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Vivid Street taught me what's most important when it comes to singing, and she already knows all of that.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
So, I believe...
I believe An will be able to carry our dreams forward.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: But An's still just a girl...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Things are going to be so painful for her if she learns that I'm gone for good.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Everything we did together, including singing... All those good memories might turn into things she never wants to think about again.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Which might cause her to quit music.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I really don't want that to happen.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I know. I'm acting like a little kid.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Asking everyone to pretend that I'm still out there somewhere.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: A part of why I did that is because I want to stay with them forever...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: But I also want to see An and the next generation take up our mantle. I want to see what that future holds.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Even after I'm just reduced to a name on a headstone, I want to see it happen.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: That's why I'm doing this...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: So, um...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Once you feel An is strong enough to handle hearing about what happened to me...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Please, tell her everything.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Tell her... Tell her I believe in her...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Including what we talked about today.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: By that point, she won't be the little girl who always sulks whenever I can't practice with her.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: She'll have blossomed into a beautiful, cool young woman, who can move the hearts of everyone in this city. She'll be one of the best musicians out there.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Yeah, okay...
I'll tell her then. I promise...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Got it... Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Taiga...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Thanks for teaching me how to sing.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I got to have an amazing, fun life because you did.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah... It was fun...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: A week later...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Nagi passed away.
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
This is why RAD WEEKEND happened.
This is how RADder ended. You now know everything...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Aunt Nagi...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Tell her... Tell her I believe in her...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Aunt...Nagi...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why didn't you just tell me yourself...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because now... I...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I can't even thank you...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There's so much I wanted to tell you...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You were supposed to meet Kohane...! And Akito and Toya...! You were supposed to tell me I'd found the best team ever...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And you were supposed to see the moment we did it...! When we surpassed RAD WEEKEND...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You were supposed to do all of that...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But you're gone...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Th-That's not fair...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: *Tears of sorrow*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Nagi...! Aunt Nagi...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You said we'd perform on stage together...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Aunt Nagi...!!!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Nagi kept thinking about you all the way up until the end...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
She believed in you.
She thought you would be the one to carry our dreams.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: An.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I feel the same way as her. I believe you will.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Your third event gave me all the proof I needed to see.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You've come this far. You know how to put on events like that now. And you have a great group of friends.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You're plenty strong now.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Needless to say, the path ahead of you is going to be rough.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You'll run into a few walls along the way and get stuck. You'll keep wondering if you've reached your ceiling... Just like me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: But you...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I believe you'll figure out a way to get there. The place Nagi wasn't able to reach.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: With your friends here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You mean beyond you guys' dream? Aunt Nagi's dream...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: An, over here!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I've made my decision...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm done wondering.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Aunt Nagi placed her faith in me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She said she believes that we can carry her dream forward...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, I'm gonna do it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND and show you guys what things look like from on top of the world!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Let's do that, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: When we battled against Taiga earlier today, it reminded me of this one time I heard my dad perform...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I remember thinking he was just so much better than me. That he was far beyond my reach...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The old me ran...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I don't want to anymore.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I want us to go even higher.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I want us to surpass RAD WEEKEND...
I want to see what it's like from on top of the world.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Don't you, Akito...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
You took the words right out of my mouth.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But to be honest... I don't really know how we're gonna do all that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: When Okazaki said that he didn't know if we could ever surpass RAD WEEKEND, a part of me agreed with him.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Even if we do somehow manage to get better...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, it happened because one person literally put their life on the line. It was her swan song. And everyone she knew helped her make it happen. How do we top that...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: At the same time, thinking probably isn't gonna get us anywhere...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This is the path we chose. We're going to surpass that night.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: At this point, there's no turning back.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I wish I could've met Nagi...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I would've told her how...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Because you found me... Because you believed in me, I'm here singing with you now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I can't unfortunately...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But we can do our best to respect Nagi's wishes.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So, An, let's do it!
Together!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks, you guys...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Let's do it.
This is our real starting point.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We're gonna get even better.
We're gonna get Arata, Kotaro and EVER back...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Akito, Kohane & Toya
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Okay!
Yes!
<*Sob*>
<*Sob*>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: *Cry*

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Try to settle down, Rin.
Your eyes are going to turn all red if you keep crying like that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: B-But...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
But I understand how you two feel.
I mean, that story was so heartbreaking...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, it was...
Just thinking about what everyone was feeling... Oh, I think I'm tearing up...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But An and the others... They didn't back down. They don't want to disappoint Nagi.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Which means we have to keep giving them all the support we can.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Rin, thank you for coming to get us.
Also, we'll need to apologize to An and the others for eavesdropping.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
And no more crying, you two.
An and the others just made a big decision to stay on the path they chose.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, let's keep doing our best for them!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, I guess we need to start discussing our next move.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. Starting with...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (Are you seeing this, Nagi...?)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (The next generation you talked about is right here, and you won't believe how incredible they are...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (Which means I should probably start getting my act together.)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (Because all I can do for them at this point is...)
